name: RfcHierarchyReviewFingerprint
purpose: Exact reviewed-correction freshness for reparent/detach. It composes current LLD-03 structural review facts with the complete bounded LLD-05 history authority so reviewed consequences cannot drift while hierarchy remains unchanged.
availability: Only when RfcHierarchyHistoryAuthorityV1.status=READY. INDETERMINATE produces no review fingerprint and cannot authorize mutation.
ordering: blockers use validate_parent_child closed validator order then code UTF-8; warnings use closed validator order then code UTF-8
canonicalization: Serialize the exact closed object with LLD-01 StrictVersionedJson canonical_json exactly (ensure_ascii=false, allow_nan=false, sort_keys=true, separators=(',',':'), UTF-8); no extra keys are permitted.
digest: lowercase SHA-256 hex over exact canonical UTF-8 bytes
command_rule: Writer reconstructs this object from current owner/provider authority before receipt/mutation. HIGH requires exact supplied review_fingerprint; LOW permits null, but if a fingerprint is supplied it must exactly match. Any structural, blocker/warning or LLD-05 provider fingerprint/count change invalidates the old review even if history_risk remains HIGH or LOW.
provider_boundary: Only risk/count/provider_fingerprint cross from LLD-05. No Task/WFM/Objective row, body, description or history list is copied into LLD-03 request, result or audit.
